## Design

### 2026-10-13 – This was Day 1 of working on WASO. It's my first time using OnShape so it took a while to get a hang of the controls but once I did I was able to build the base housing of the bird. I spent a long tim

**6.33h**

This was Day 1 of working on WASO. It's my first time using OnShape so it took a while to get a hang of the controls but once I did I was able to build the base housing of the bird. I spent a long time looking at sketches of Albatrosses and trying to figure out the best may to model it, eventually deciding on a spline curved base with holes for wings

### 2026-10-16 – Continued to work on the fuselage, added a loft to round out the shape a bit more and I think im happy with it. Only isssue is that i had some trouble making the loft fit to the curve of the spline so

**2.62h**

Continued to work on the fuselage, added a loft to round out the shape a bit more and I think im happy with it. Only isssue is that i had some trouble making the loft fit to the curve of the spline so i had to add more pierce constraints to get it to work. Next im going to hollow out the interior for electronics and then start to work on the wings
